units.source_text: 这个世界的灵魂同那个世界的灵魂——由热情的精灵组成的一团士兵，

en.t: the souls of this world and the souls of that world -- a band of soldiers made up of passionate spirits,

units.source_text: 为了消除死亡能把人们隔开的传统观念，

en.t: in order to erase the traditional idea that death can separate people,

units.source_text: 正在这两个世界之间架桥铺路，

en.t: are now building bridges and laying roads between these two worlds,

units.source_text: 以便从这个世界上消灭死别的悲伤。

en.t: so that the sorrow of parting by death may be wiped from this world.
